title: By the Waters of Babylon

questions.question: By the waters of Babylon, there we sat down and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 137:1 (ESV): "By the waters of Babylon, there we sat down and wept,"

questions.question: On the willows there we hung up our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 137:2 (ESV): "On the willows there we hung up our lyres."

questions.question: For there our captors required of us what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 137:3 (ESV): "For there our captors required of us songs,"

questions.question: Sing us one of the songs of where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 137:3 (ESV): "'Sing us one of the songs of Zion!'"

questions.question: How shall we sing the Lord's song in a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 137:4 (ESV): "How shall we sing the Lord's song in a foreign land?"

questions.question: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 137:5 (ESV): "...let my right hand forget its skill!"

questions.question: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I do not do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 137:6 (ESV): "Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I do not remember you,"

questions.question: If I do not set Jerusalem above my highest what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 137:6 (ESV): "if I do not set Jerusalem above my highest joy!"

questions.question: Remember, O Lord, against the Edomites the day of Jerusalem, how they said, "Lay it bare, lay it bare, down to its what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 137:7 (ESV): "'Lay it bare, lay it bare, down to its foundations!'"

questions.question: O daughter of Babylon, doomed to be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 137:8 (ESV): "O daughter of Babylon, doomed to be destroyed,"

questions.question: Blessed shall he be who repays you with what you have done to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 137:8 (ESV): "...with what you have done to us!"

questions.question: Blessed shall he be who takes your little ones and dashes them against the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 137:9 (ESV): "...and dashes them against the rock!"

questions.question: What instrument is mentioned in verse 2?

key_verse_text: By the waters of Babylon, there we sat down and wept, when we remembered Zion.
